rationale.proposedRelation: new current ownership/source population; direct, supporting or indirect applicability not assumed
rationale.evidenceDuty: Read exact current bodies and owner/source relations; assess trigger and phase for this whole declared member domain.
rationale.disposition: unassessed; no automatic inapplicability, waiver, common satisfaction or runtime gate
rationale.unresolvedAlternatives: Owner/trigger/phase differences may falsify common grouping; split only at the affected domain with existing scope carriers.

relation.trigger: publishing requirement, span, context or evidence relations
relation.governedSubject: inert requirement declaration and stable proof-role references
relation.sharedEvidenceDuty: requirements declaration conformance and S06 source/obligation/route binding; declarations are not admitted runtime facts
relation.judgment: independent applicability, common grouping and sufficiency not yet admitted

ruleRationale.groupingProposal: Common exact family trigger/subject/owner/phase: contextual definitions and its obligations assessed together over the declared whole owner scope. No additional source population or changed applicability is introduced; independent J remains required.
residuals: compound or contextual source rows require explicit source-grounded interpretation; catalog fidelity alone cannot establish applicability
ruleRationale.status: independent common scope/applicability/adequacy J required; updated source bodies govern
